description: Fabric port of AutoPalette 1.2.4 for Minecraft Java 26.2

mods.name: AutoPalette
mods.description: A client-side mod to automatically draw images on ArtMap canvases.

releases.notes:
Improves stroke placement when moving between canvas rows.

- Adds a short aiming pause after moving to a new row or jumping across pixels.
- Spaces strokes to respect ArtMap's brush cooldown, including shading clicks.
- Uses Snake as the initial painting order to avoid sweeping back across each completed row. Other orders remain selectable in game.

Requires Minecraft 26.2, Fabric Loader, and Fabric API.

mods.name: AutoPalette
mods.description: A client-side mod to automatically draw images on ArtMap canvases.

releases.notes:
Select the ArtMap canvas resolution in game: 32×32, 64×64, or 128×128. The preview and materials list now use the selected resolution.

Choose how the image fills the canvas: Fit (keeps the full image with white borders), Fill (crops to the canvas), or Stretch.

Painting now starts in row order by default. Color-Optimized remains available from the Order button. The painter aims at the center of each pixel for the selected canvas size.

Requires Minecraft 26.2, Fabric Loader, and Fabric API.

mods.name: AutoPalette
mods.description: A client-side mod to automatically draw images on ArtMap canvases.

releases.notes:
Adds **Export Materials** to the Materials tab. For the selected painting, it saves the complete materials list as TXT and CSV in `config/autopalette/exports` and copies the TXT list to the clipboard.

Requires Minecraft Java 26.2, Java 25, Fabric Loader 0.19.3 or newer, and Fabric API for 26.2. Install the attached JAR in the client `mods` folder.
